tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List every market covered (≈100: US and world indices, US and Asian stocks, crypto, FX, rates, commodities) with its latest called Elliott Wave count in one sentence and its invalidation price. Optionally filter by group.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Full Elliott Wave count for one market at its latest close: the called count and its invalidation price, and for each timeframe (monthly, weekly, daily, hourly, 15-minute) the wave in progress, target zone and invalidation. Returns Markdown.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Markets whose Elliott Wave call was changed or invalidated recently, newest first.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Find markets by symbol, name or group, e.g. 'semiconductors', 'yen', 'india'.
